findings.issue: 37 distinct font-size declarations found.
findings.recommendation: Reduce to a controlled typography scale for page title, section title, body, table, caption and KPI values.

findings.issue: 28 different border-radius values found.
findings.recommendation: Standardize radius tokens for controls, cards, dialogs and badges.

findings.issue: 75 form controls may rely on placeholder/context instead of a persistent label.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a common field component: label + control + optional hint/error. Do not use placeholders as field names.
